mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 66 degree temperatures with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and under the full moon, please note the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will drop to 58 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The Planning Department is reminding residents to be vigilant against scams involving permit fees, noting that fees must be paid by check at City Hall, while public works crews are preparing for fall leaf collection which begins October 5.
There is plenty to do with yoga at Insight Wellness and trivia at Hop Haus occurring today, followed by live music and the Verona Fall Fest starting tomorrow.
On September 5, officers responded to a peculiar series of reports regarding vehicles having slices of cheese placed on their windshields as part of an internet trend.
While we usually love sharing the flavor of the day, Culver's of Verona is currently closed today for a scheduled remodel.
